content: Current stable Go is 1.27 (go1.27.1 verified locally; 1.27 released 2026-08-19). encoding/json/v2 became default-enabled stdlib in Go 1.27 with v1 reimplemented on the v2 engine (migration guide go.dev/doc/jsonv2-migration). testing/synctest is stable since Go 1.25 (no GOEXPERIMENT needed) giving virtual-time deterministic test bubbles.
